name: SharedInfobox
author: Hitchwiki
description: One infobox per concept, owned by the English wiki. On a non-English wiki, an article whose English counterpart is known (via the shared page_translations table of CentralLangLinks) renders the English article's leading infobox instead of carrying its own copy, so the facts are edited in exactly one place.

SharedInfoboxSourceLanguage.description: Language code of the wiki that owns the infoboxes. Pages on this wiki are never touched.

SharedInfoboxSourceApi.description: api.php of the source wiki. Defaults to the container-internal Apache so the fetch bypasses the public interstitial, mirroring the `hwen` interwiki prefix.

SharedInfoboxSourceArticlePath.description: Article path of the source wiki, used to recognise links that can be pointed at a local translation instead.

SharedInfoboxCacheExpiry.description: Seconds a fetched infobox is reused before the source wiki is asked again.

SharedInfoboxCacheType.description: Object cache to hold fetched infoboxes. CACHE_ANYTHING falls back to the database when no in-memory cache is configured, which matters here because $wgMainCacheType is CACHE_NONE and the WAN cache would therefore store nothing at all.
